backend/servers/api-server/src/services/actions/api_call.rs:251 — validate_external_url() runs ONCE on the initial URL only; the request is issued at 257-261 and sent at 307 (request.send().await), transparently following 3xx redirects. A permitted external endpoint that responds 30x to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ (or any internal 10.x/127.x host) is followed with NO re-validation of the hop target — SSRF bypass via redirect.
